Hopeful handover, hats off the service crew
It was a good run
Smooth shifts for pets and people

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is keeping things calm, clear, and kind for every traveler who comes through with a pet. The senior coordinator is steady on daily choices, while the welfare coordinator keeps comfort front and center, so staff can spot worries early and respond with care. <<FACT F001>> When a traveler feels unsure, the team listens first, then offers simple next steps that make the day easier.

At the same time, the handoff routine is getting a nice polish, with tidy checks, friendly updates, and a little extra attention for nervous animals and their humans. <<FACT F027>> That means better flow at the counter, less fuss in the lounge, and more confidence for anyone heading out with a pet. The goal is simple: keep every journey smooth, safe, and welcoming from start to finish.
